ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
109
STUDY 097
Striped Hooded Cardigan & Leopard Skirt
Rights check
Source: 24989.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy blonde hair
wears a fuzzy blue and brown striped knit cardigan with
a hood, a bow tie at the neck, and small brown buttons.
A leopard-print skirt shows at the hip. Her expression is
calm and direct against a soft gray backdrop. Soft, even
studio light. Palette of powder blue, chocolate, and
leopard tan. Playful and cozy, in the style of a knitwear
catalog.
Playful, cozy, sweet
WORKING NOTES
- The striped hood and bow tie are the signature details.
- Add 'head to toe' to show the skirt.
Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to show the skirt.
